AI Chatbot Developer

We are seeking a talented AI Chatbot Developer to build a prototype for a personal project– an AI chatbot to simulate a conversation with a particular historical figure. The successful candidate will be responsible for building, maintaining, and improving a chatbot that simulates conversations. This role requires a deep understanding of natural language processing, machine learning, and chatbot development. Project owner will be providing the raw data sources for model training (but experience with data preparation is required). Qualifications: -A degree in a relevant field, such as Computer Science or Artificial Intelligence -3+ years of experience in chatbot development preferred -Strong understanding of NLP techniques, including language generation and conversation flow management -Experience with AI platforms such as OpenAI GPT, Dialogflow, or similar (and open source alternative like gpt-neox) -Knowledge of deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch -Strong coding skills in Python or other relevant programming languages -Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills -Familiarity with model deployment on cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Heroku, or Google Cloud -Proven ability to work effectively as a single contributor on a project -Knowledge of agile software development methodologies Responsibilities: -Design and develop a chatbot that can simulate conversations with historical figures using OpenAI GPT or similar AI platforms (or open source alternative like gpt-neox) -Work independently for large chunks of time under the direction of project owner -Implement conversational flows and features such as context management, entity recognition, and sentiment analysis -Train the chatbot on large datasets of historical figure writings to improve its accuracy and consistency (data could include speeches, lectures, news articles, letters, etc, etc) -Monitor chatbot performance and implement improvements as needed -Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI and NLP technologies -If you are a driven and motivated AI/ML developer with a passion for building cutting-edge chatbots, we encourage you to apply for this opportunity.
</untrusted>
